name: CosyVoice2-0.5B
access: Hugging Face weights FunAudioLLM/CosyVoice2-0.5B and ModelScope
FunAudioLLM/CosyVoice repository: Python, vLLM and TensorRT-LLM serving, FastAPI and gRPC servers

voice.input_audio: Text, a short reference clip and, in instruct mode, a short instruction ending with the end-of-prompt token [cosy-example]
voice.output_audio: A waveform tensor with the model's sample rate, saved by the caller; streaming chunks are supported [cosy-example]
voice.voices: custom cloning from a reference clip [cosy-gh]
voice.interruption: Not a conversation model: the client stops playback

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Open weights, no price. TensorRT-LLM serving is said to run the language model about four times faster than Hugging Face Transformers [cosy-gh]
